def: The name, plain-language description and JSON Schema of a function that a model may request; the model sees this and never the function's code.
A standard vocabulary for describing the shape of a JSON document, used to specify the arguments of each tool.
A content block in an assistant message in which the model requests a tool by name, with an id and an input object.
A content block in a user message that answers one tool_use request, matched by tool_use_id and flagged with is_error when the tool failed.
A rule enforced by the harness that ends an agent loop, such as an iteration cap, token budget, timeout or repeated-call detection.
A cap on the number of model calls an agent may make for one task, bounding cost and time.
Several tool_use blocks in one assistant turn, all of which must be answered together in the next user message.
A unique value sent with a side-effecting request so that a repeat of the same request returns the first result instead of acting twice.
Storing the processed form of a repeated prompt prefix so later calls read it at a reduced price and latency.
The program around the model that holds the history, runs tools, enforces limits and decides when the loop ends.
